rationale: CDNA is trading at the absolute top of its intraday range (position 100%) after a 12.72% gap-up on strong earnings, with the last print at $89.86 already exceeding today's prior high of $89.00 — momentum is extended but chasing at the high with a 87.9 bps spread and volatile 1-minute candles creates unfavorable risk/reward in either direction. The broader market is under pressure (SPY -1.26%, VIXY +6.51%), which could cap further upside on a gap-and-run name, yet the fundamental catalyst is strong enough to make a short equally dangerous. With no clean technical level to anchor a stop that doesn't consume excessive capital, and the stock in price discovery above all intraday structure, the asymmetry is insufficient to justify entry.
